oddsnote: 100,000 full-season simulations (regular season + playoff bracket). Weekly player projections, optimized lineups (no K/DEF), bye and injury holes filled with a waiver add (top-5 free agent average). League tiebreakers applied. This week's finished games are locked in: those starters count at their actual points in their actual slots, and only players who haven't kicked off are projected.
elimnote: Shown only when no combination of results and tiebreakers could save the team — a spot still reachable via a points-for tiebreak counts as alive.
brinknote: On the brink: those results leave no path to the playoffs without winning a points-for tiebreak. The percentage is the team's playoff odds across 100,000 simulations if the loss happens; under 1% counts as effectively out.

paths.text: Even winning out only gets Will to 6-8 — and the path needs the middle to collapse: Austin (6-3) can't win again; Steve (5-4) can win at most 1 more; Luke (3-6) can win at most 3 more. pathnote: The easiest surviving world from a search of the remaining schedule, shown for teams under 2% simulated playoff odds. Records include this week's finished games; points-for totals run through the last fully scored week.
